D.treatment: Quiet Eye Training including an EMME video

O.outcome_detail: Expected gaze behavior and novice performance

cells.quote: "In literature on QET, the EMME video is typically an aspect of the full training (i.e., not the main manipulation) aimed at modeling the expected gaze behavior to the novice and contrasting the quiet eye behavior of the novice and the expert"
cells.note: This quote is from the wiki entry, not the supplied study text. The supplied study text identifies a Quiet Eye Training cluster of 19 articles but does not report the comparison, outcome direction, participant characteristics, setting, duration, or effect size for this cluster.
